text:
AR102
Doing Archaeology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
Lab: 1.3
This
course
builds on the fundamentals of archaeological practice, using case studies to illustrate methods and theoretical approaches undertaken in modern archaeology. A global perspective is taken on issues of concern to archaeologists today including site excavation and recording, the most recent scientific advancements, relevancy of archaeology to contemporary issues, conservation and protection of archaeological resources through legislation. Weekly labs provide hands-on experience with artifact analysis and interpretation.
